title: Fast Nanophotonic Inverse Design using Precomputed Numerical Green Functions
summary: Inverse design has been transformative in nanophotonics, providing an automated means of realizing high-performance, non-intuitive devices. However, the primary bottleneck of existing inverse design approaches is their reliance on time-consuming and computationally expensive full-wave electromagnetic simulations. In this work, we extend the Precomputed Numerical Green Function (PNGF) method for the first time to nanophotonic inverse design, accelerating evaluation of the forward problem by multiple orders of magnitude with no loss in accuracy compared to the full-wave solution.
